regime_read: The evidence pack today shows a semiconductor-capital-equipment and memory-related policy tilt converging with disclosed political holdings, but the desk has zero measured track record, so all conviction is capped low and extended names are deferred. The cleanest alignment is AMAT — laggard, consensus bullish, multi-channel but modest — followed by a memory-adjacent policy catalyst that remains only a study mandate.
regime_read_zh: 今日证据包显示半导体资本设备与存储器相关政策倾斜与政治人物持仓公开信息有所汇聚，但本台尚无已评分的研判记录，所有确信度被限制在低位，且已超涨的个股不予追入。最干净的聚力在 AMAT —— 落后于大盘、一致看多、多通道但强度有限；其次是一条仅属研究授权的存储器政策催化，尚未成形。

theses.thesis: AMAT is the only genuinely lagging name among a cohort of consensus-bullish, multi-channel semiconductor-adjacent reads: rs_vs_spy_60d at -29.1 means it has not run while the policy and sentiment channels turn up. Congress net buying is +4 across four members (~$54M position) [congress_cluster, congress_net], analyst bull ratio 0.97 [analyst_upgrade_cluster], news bull 0.86 [news_sentiment], patent cluster at 293 [patent_cluster], and unusually high options volume/OI with near-parity put/call 1.07 [unusual_options]. The Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act (HR10170, semis) is only a Commerce study mandate, so it is a theme tailwind, not a near-term demand shock. Convergence score 5 is meaningful but not overwhelming, and weight 2.4 is the highest in the pack.
theses.thesis_zh: AMAT 是半导体相关板块中唯一真正落后的个股：来自 60 日相对 SPY 的超额收益为 -29.1，意味着它在政策与情绪通道同步转暖之前并未上涨。国会净买入 +4、4 名议员持仓约 5400 万美元 [congress_cluster、congress_net]，分析师看多比率 0.97 [analyst_upgrade_cluster]，新闻看多 0.86 [news_sentiment]，专利聚集 293 项 [patent_cluster]，期权量/持仓异常高且认沽认购近乎相当 1.07 [unusual_options]。《存储芯片竞争力评估法》（HR10170，半导体）目前仅为商务部的研究授权，因此只是主题性顺风而非近期需求冲击。汇聚评分 5 有意义但并不压倒，加权分 2.4 为全表最高。
second_order: MU — memory is the named beneficiary of HR10170's advanced-memory study, and MU has its own insider-MSPR plus stocktwits bull alignment [insider_mspr, stocktwits_bull, bill_catalyst HR10170]
NVDA — a confirmed political-holdings and analyst-upgrade cluster beneficiary that rides the same AI/accelerator capex that AMAT's exposed to [actor:Pelosi, analyst_upgrade_cluster]
LRCX/KLAC (off-pack) — WFE peers that typically move with AMAT on foundry/logic expansion, not cited in pack
theses.dissent: The options put/call at 1.07 is not bullish-skewed — it is near parity, so the unusual volume may reflect hedging rather than directional conviction.

falsifier.text: AMAT breaks below its 60-day relative plateau while the Congress net-buy reverses in the next quarterly disclosure, or the Memory Chip Act stalls in committee past the horizon.

theses.thesis: MU is a second-order beneficiary with an independent primary read: insider MSPR pinned at 100 [insider_mspr], 446 patents [patent_cluster], and a maxed stocktwits bull ratio [stocktwits_bull], with the Memory Chip Competitiveness Assessment Act (HR10170) pending in the House as a study mandate [bill_catalyst]. But it reports earnings in 3 days (2026-09-30) with an 18.6% expected surprise, so an ACCUMULATE now is an event bet the desk does not underwrite; WATCH through the print. The rs_vs_spy_60d at 1.2 shows no underlying edge is priced in yet.
theses.thesis_zh: MU 作为第二顺位受益者同时具有独立主线：内部人 MSPR 满分 100 [insider_mspr]，专利 446 项 [patent_cluster]，Stocktwits 看多比率 1.0 [stocktwits_bull]，并叠加众议院内存芯片竞争力评估法案（HR10170）[bill_catalyst]。但它在 3 天后（2026-09-30）披露财报、预期偏差 18.6%，此刻介入是一次事件博弈，本台不背书；宜观望过财报。60 日相对 SPY 仅 1.2，显示尚无底层优势被计价。
second_order: AMAT — the capital-equipment side of the same memory-complexity theme, already the desk's primary read
NVDA — needs high-bandwidth memory, so an advanced-memory study namedens HR10170's eventual competitiveness framing
theses.dissent: Insider MSPR is a fragile signal with no direction disclosed in the pack, and the stocktwits bull ratio is a retail-chasing channel with weak timing value.

falsifier.text: MU prints earnings and the stock fails to hold a post-earnings gain while the Memory Chip Act's study mandate stalls in committee.

theses.thesis: CRWD has a compact but high-quality alignment: Trump-linked buy side [trump], 13F addition [13f_add], Congress buying at net +4 across two members (~$115M) [congress_buy, congress_cluster], and analyst bull 0.89 [analyst_upgrade_cluster]. But rs_vs_spy_60d of +26.8 means it has already moved with these flows, and the pack gives it no patent or demand channel to stack against the political money.
theses.thesis_zh: CRWD 具有紧凑但高质量的聚力：与特朗普关联的买方 [trump]、13F 加仓 [13f_add]、国会买入净 +4 且两名议员持仓约 1.15 亿美元 [congress_buy、congress_cluster]，分析师看多 0.89 [analyst_upgrade_cluster]。但其 60 日超额 +26.8 表明已随这些资金走了一程，且本表未给出专利或需求通道来叠加于政治资金之上。
second_order: PANW (off-pack) — the cybersecurity peer that typically trades with CRWD on federal IT-modernization themes, not cited in pack
theses.dissent: After a +26.8 60-day relative run, the marginal buyer is likely already in, and Congress buy-only data lags by design.

falsifier.text: CRWD gives back more than half its 60-day relative gain on no new 13F add, or the Trump-linked buy side flips to sell.

theses.thesis: BA is the only short-side actionable read in the pack, thin but directional. Cramer ENDORSES [actor:Cramer, influence_graph], with persistent stocktwits bull chatter [stocktwits_bull], while rs_vs_spy_60d shows the trend is still down (-13.1) and a patent cluster of 231 is not an earnings tailwind. A gov_grant channel of $7.8M [gov_grant] is immaterial. This is a contrarian lean against a name whose political/affiliated attachment is weak.
theses.thesis_zh: BA 是本表中唯一可行动的看空方向，论据虽薄但有方向性。Cramer 公开背书 [actor:Cramer、influence_graph]，Stocktwits 持续看多 [stocktwits_bull]，而 60 日相对 SPY 的下跌趋势仍未止（-13.1），231 项专利 [patent_cluster] 也不构成盈利顺风。780 万美元的政府补助 [gov_grant] 规模微乎其微。这是对政治/附属关联较弱个股的一次反向倾向。
second_order: SPR (off-pack) — BA's largest aerostructures supplier, exposed to the same delivery/quality overhang, not cited in pack
theses.dissent: A short-side read built on a Cramer endorsement and weak retail chatter is thin; aerospace names can re-rate quickly on a single delivery milestone.

falsifier.text: BA breaks back above its 60-day relative flat line and Cramer's endorsement is followed by an analyst-upgrade cluster not present today.
